summary: The bill expands expedited removal proceedings for incarcerated or non-incarcerated aliens who are criminal gang members, foreign terrorist organization members, or convicted of felonies, certain misdemeanors against vulnerable people, assaults on officers, sexual offenses, domestic violence, stalking, child-related crimes, or protection-order violations by amending the Immigration and Nationality Act to broaden section 238 proceedings, mandate DHS detention, and bar asylum and other relief.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends immigration enforcement procedures under the INA to expand expedited removal and detention for certain criminal aliens. It contains no provisions authorizing, increasing, or decreasing federal appropriations or spending levels.
The bill contains no provisions related to tax rates, tax policy, deductions, credits, or revenue collection.
The bill contains no provisions related to healthcare delivery, insurance, public coverage, or market-based reforms.
The bill references existing firearms offenses as one category among many that can trigger expedited removal when committed by noncitizens, but it creates no new gun regulations or restrictions.

The bill's core purpose is to expand expedited removal proceedings, mandatory detention, and bars to asylum and other relief for aliens who are criminal gang members, foreign terrorist organization members, or convicted of specified crimes. These changes directly strengthen border enforcement and removal mechanisms while narrowing immigration protections and relief.
The bill contains no provisions related to abortion access or restrictions.
The bill contains no provisions related to military or defense spending or policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to environmental regulations or protections.
The bill contains no provisions related to welfare programs, food assistance, or other safety-net benefits.
The bill contains no provisions related to schools, school choice, or federal education policy.

The bill incorporates certain drug-related offenses into the definition of criminal gang activity for immigration purposes, but it does not alter domestic drug enforcement, decriminalization, or sentencing policies.
The bill addresses immigration consequences of criminal convictions rather than altering domestic criminal sentencing, policing, or rehabilitation policies.
The bill contains no provisions related to trade, tariffs, or globalization.
The bill contains no provisions addressing deficits, debt reduction, or fiscal policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to legal protections or rights for LGBTQ+ individuals.
The bill contains no provisions related to foreign aid.
The bill contains no provisions related to voting access or election integrity.
The bill contains no provisions related to technology regulation or data privacy.
The bill contains no provisions related to labor rights or unions.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious exemptions or civil rights protections.
